## Purpose
Refine a saved workflow by conversation: say what to change, review the proposal on the graph, apply it, undo it, and publish when it is right.

## Responsibilities
- `RefineWorkspace({name, executionId, origin})` lays out `RefineConversation`, `RefineCanvas`, `ValidationPanel` and the version history, with a resizable split.
- It is driven by `useWorkflowRefine`.
